name: inflowave
description:
Inflowave is the CRM and inbox for businesses that sell through Instagram. Connect your account to ask ChatGPT how the business is doing, find any lead with their notes and history, see your pipeline and move deals forward, check upcoming calls, read your inbox, and keep the CRM up to date with notes, tags and tasks.

Nothing is sent to your contacts from ChatGPT: the app reads and updates your own CRM only. You only ever see your own account's data, and every change is shown to you before it is made.

Nothing is sent to your contacts from ChatGPT: the app reads and updates your own CRM only. You only ever see your own account's data, and every change is shown to you before it is made.
capabilities: See dashboard numbers, Instagram growth and team performance
Search leads and review their notes, activity and journey
See pipeline stages and deals, create deals and move them between stages
Read the inbox and conversation history
Review form submissions, campaigns and automation results
Add leads, notes, tags and tasks
defaultPrompt: How did my business do this week?
Which deals in my pipeline need a follow-up?

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my business: leads, pipeline and conversations.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises lead, conversation and pipeline totals for the account.

positive.description: Find a lead and read notes
positive.prompt: Find my lead Sarah Mitchell and show her latest notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Sarah Mitchell and lists her notes, newest first.

positive.prompt: What deals are in my pipeline and which stage is each in?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists deals grouped by stage (New Leads, Qualified, Call Booked, Clients) with values.

positive.prompt: Add a note to Sarah Mitchell: called today, follow up Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: States the change, then saves the note on Sarah Mitchell's lead and confirms it.

positive.prompt: What calls do I have booked this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming calls with time and contact name.

negative.prompt: Cancel all my booked calls this week.
Upgrade my Inflowave plan and buy more credits.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and update your Inflowave CRM from ChatGPT.
